description: This source file contains the implementation of a class named TimestampOrderNumberGenerator, which is a Java component implementing the OrderNumberGenerator interface. It generates order numbers based on a context attribute or the current timestamp, primarily for testing purposes within the OpenMRS project.

classes.name: TimestampOrderNumberGenerator
classes.description: A test implementation of OrderNumberGenerator that returns a predefined order number from context or generates one based on current timestamp.

methods.name: getNewOrderNumber
methods.description: Returns a new order number, either from the provided OrderContext attribute or by generating one with a prefix and timestamp.
